mapper.sql: `id`,`task_id` AS taskId,`pro_id` AS proId,`pro_sub_type` AS proSubType, `pro_code` AS proCode,`topic_name` AS topicName,`company_name` AS companyName, `group_name` AS groupName,`expert_uid` AS expertUid,`expert_name` AS expertName, `grade`,`remark`,`deleted`,`created`,`updated`
mapper.select: select from ass_surver_expert_eliminate where task_id = #{taskId} and pro_id = #{proId} and expert_uid = #{expertUid} limit 1
mapper.update: update ass_surver_expert_eliminate set deleted = 1, updated = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT e.task_id AS taskId, e.pro_id AS proId, e.pro_sub_type AS proSubType, MAX(e.pro_code) AS proCode,
MAX(p.chengguo) AS topicName, MAX(sd.name) AS companyName, (SELECT qg.name FROM ass_qc_group qg WHERE qg.groupid = p.group_id AND qg.taskid = p.publish_task_id LIMIT 1) AS groupName, MAX(p.declare_account) AS declareAccount, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT eg.name ORDER BY eg.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group peg JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid WHERE peg.proid = e.pro_id) AS expertGroupName, SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeA, SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeB, SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeC, SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade='D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeD, SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade IS NULL OR e.grade = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeEmpty, COUNT(*) AS totalRows, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(':', IFNULL(e.expert_name,''), IFNULL(e.grade,'-')) ORDER BY e.expert_uid SEPARATOR '|') AS expertGrades, CASE e.pro_sub_type WHEN 'design' THEN (SELECT IFNULL(t.eliminated,0) FROM ass_surver_design_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = e.pro_id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'software' THEN (SELECT IFNULL(t.eliminated,0) FROM ass_surver_soft_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = e.pro_id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'standard' THEN (SELECT IFNULL(t.eliminated,0) FROM ass_surver_standard_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = e.pro_id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'contribution' THEN (SELECT IFNULL(t.eliminated,0) FROM ass_surver_excellent_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = e.pro_id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE 0 END AS eliminated FROM ass_surver_expert_eliminate e LEFT JOIN ass_award_enterprise_project p ON p.id = e.pro_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = p.create_uid LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = su.dept_id WHERE e.task_id = #{taskId} AND e.deleted = 0
AND e.pro_sub_type = #{proSubType}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group cpeg JOIN ass_award_expert_group ceg ON ceg.groupid = cpeg.groupid AND ceg.taskid = cpeg.taskid JOIN add_special_info csi ON csi.group_name = ceg.name AND csi.task_id = cpeg.taskid AND csi.user_id = #{contactUserId} AND csi.pro_type = 'surver_view_scope' AND csi.deleted = 0 WHERE cpeg.proid = e.pro_id )
GROUP BY e.task_id, e.pro_id, e.pro_sub_type ORDER BY gradeD DESC, gradeC DESC, e.pro_sub_type, e.pro_id

choose.when: UPDATE ass_surver_design_apply_table_info SET eliminated = #{eliminated} WHERE pro_id = #{proId} AND eliminated != #{eliminated}
UPDATE ass_surver_soft_apply_table_info SET eliminated = #{eliminated} WHERE pro_id = #{proId} AND eliminated != #{eliminated}
UPDATE ass_surver_standard_apply_table_info SET eliminated = #{eliminated} WHERE pro_id = #{proId} AND eliminated != #{eliminated}
UPDATE ass_surver_excellent_apply_table_info SET eliminated = #{eliminated} WHERE pro_id = #{proId} AND eliminated != #{eliminated}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE ass_surver_expert_eliminate SET id = id WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when: INSERT INTO ass_surver_design_apply_table_info (pro_id, eliminated) SELECT #{proId}, #{eliminated} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ass_surver_design_apply_table_info WHERE pro_id = #{proId})
INSERT INTO ass_surver_soft_apply_table_info (pro_id, eliminated) SELECT #{proId}, #{eliminated} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ass_surver_soft_apply_table_info WHERE pro_id = #{proId})

INSERT INTO ass_surver_standard_apply_table_info (pro_id, eliminated) SELECT #{proId}, #{eliminated} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ass_surver_standard_apply_table_info WHERE pro_id = #{proId})

INSERT INTO ass_surver_excellent_apply_table_info (pro_id, eliminated) SELECT #{proId}, #{eliminated} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ass_surver_excellent_apply_table_info WHERE pro_id = #{proId})

#{taskId} UNION ALL SELECT 'standard' AS proSubType, t.pro_id AS proId, p.pro_code AS proCode, p.chengguo AS topicName, sd.name AS companyName, (SELECT qg.name FROM ass_qc_group qg WHERE qg.groupid = p.group_id AND qg.taskid = p.publish_task_id LIMIT 1) AS groupName, p.major AS major, p.declare_account AS declareAccount, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT eg.name ORDER BY eg.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group peg JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid WHERE peg.proid = p.id) AS expertGroupName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(':', 'standard' AND e2.deleted = 0) AS expertGrades FROM ass_surver_standard_apply_table_info t JOIN ass_award_enterprise_project p ON p.id = t.pro_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = p.create_uid LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = su.dept_id WHERE t.eliminated = 1 AND p.publish_task_id = #{taskId} UNION ALL SELECT 'contribution' AS proSubType, t.pro_id AS proId, p.pro_code AS proCode, p.declare_account AS declareAccount, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT eg.name ORDER BY eg.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group peg JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid WHERE peg.proid = p.id) AS expertGroupName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(':', IFNULL(e2.expert_name,''), IFNULL(e2.grade,'-')) ORDER BY e2.expert_uid SEPARATOR '|') FROM ass_surver_expert_eliminate e2 WHERE e2.task_id = #{taskId} AND e2.pro_id = p.id AND e2.pro_sub_type = 'contribution' AND e2.deleted = 0) AS expertGrades FROM ass_surver_excellent_apply_table_info t JOIN ass_award_enterprise_project p ON p.id = t.pro_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = p.create_uid LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = su.dept_id WHERE t.eliminated = 1 AND p.publish_task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY proSubType, proId

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pro.id) FROM ass_award_enterprise_project pro JOIN ass_award_pro_expert_group peg ON peg.proid = pro.id JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid JOIN add_special_info si ON si.group_name = eg.name AND si.user_id = #{uid} AND si.pro_type = 'surver_pro_group' AND si.deleted = 0 WHERE pro.pro_type = 'surver_pro' AND pro.publish_task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT p.pro_result_code AS proCode, IFNULL(p.chengguo, (SELECT cbi.chengguo_name FROM ass_enterprise_chengguo_base_info cbi WHERE cbi.pro_id = p.id LIMIT 1)) AS topicName, (SELECT eg.name FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group peg JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid WHERE peg.proid = p.id LIMIT 1) AS groupName, (SELECT sd.name FROM sys_dept sd JOIN sys_user su ON sd.dept_id = su.dept_id WHERE su.user_id = p.create_uid LIMIT 1) AS companyName FROM ass_award_enterprise_project p WHERE p.id = #{proId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pro.pro_sub_type AS proSubType, IF(pro.pro_result_code IS NULL OR pro.pro_result_code = '', pro.pro_code, pro.pro_result_code) AS proCode, COALESCE(pro.chengguo, CASE pro.pro_sub_type WHEN 'contribution' THEN (SELECT t.pro_name FROM ass_surver_excellent_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = pro.id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'design' THEN (SELECT t.pro_name FROM ass_surver_design_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = pro.id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'software' THEN (SELECT t.soft_name FROM ass_surver_soft_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = pro.id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'standard' THEN (SELECT t.gallery_name FROM ass_surver_standard_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = pro.id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'consulting' THEN (SELECT t.pro_name FROM ass_surver_consult_apply_table_info t WHERE t.pro_id = pro.id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1) END ) AS topicName, (SELECT eg.name FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group peg JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid WHERE peg.proid = pro.id LIMIT 1) AS groupName, sd.name AS companyName, e.expert_name AS expertName, e.grade AS grade, e.remark AS remark FROM ass_award_enterprise_project pro
LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = pro.create_uid LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = su.dept_id LEFT JOIN ass_surver_expert_eliminate e ON e.pro_id = pro.id AND e.task_id = #{taskId} AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE pro.publish_task_id = #{taskId} AND pro.pro_type = 'surver_pro' AND pro.pro_sub_type IN ('contribution', 'design', 'software', 'standard', 'consulting')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group cpeg JOIN ass_award_expert_group ceg ON ceg.groupid = cpeg.groupid AND ceg.taskid = cpeg.taskid JOIN add_special_info csi ON csi.group_name = ceg.name AND csi.task_id = cpeg.taskid AND csi.user_id = #{contactUserId} AND csi.pro_type = 'surver_view_scope' AND csi.deleted = 0 WHERE cpeg.proid = pro.id )
ORDER BY pro.pro_sub_type, IF(pro.pro_result_code IS NULL OR pro.pro_result_code = '', pro.pro_code, pro.pro_result_code), e.expert_uid

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ass_award_enterprise_project pro WHERE pro.id = #{proId} AND pro.pro_type = 'surver_pro' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group cpeg JOIN ass_award_expert_group ceg ON ceg.groupid = cpeg.groupid AND ceg.taskid = cpeg.taskid JOIN add_special_info csi ON csi.group_name = ceg.name AND csi.task_id = cpeg.taskid AND csi.user_id = #{contactUserId} AND csi.pro_type = 'surver_view_scope' AND csi.deleted = 0 WHERE cpeg.proid = pro.id )

SELECT DISTINCT pro.id FROM ass_award_enterprise_project pro WHERE pro.publish_task_id = #{taskId} AND pro.pro_type = 'surver_pro' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ass_award_pro_expert_group cpeg JOIN ass_award_expert_group ceg ON ceg.groupid = cpeg.groupid AND ceg.taskid = cpeg.taskid JOIN add_special_info csi ON csi.group_name = ceg.name AND csi.task_id = cpeg.taskid AND csi.user_id = #{contactUserId} AND csi.pro_type = 'surver_view_scope' AND csi.deleted = 0 WHERE cpeg.proid = pro.id )
